Class RandomBrickGenerator

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.game.bricks.RandomBrickGenerator
All Implemented Interfaces:
BrickGenerator
public class RandomBrickGenerator extends Object implements BrickGenerator
Implementation of BrickGenerator that provides a stream of random bricks. Maintains a buffer of upcoming bricks to allow the "Next Brick" preview feature.
